meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 2.1x sector median, with lightweight controls calibrated for a scaling ai_native team of up to 25 people.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only when no approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist and the receipt is submitted within 30 days.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 90% before month end
Team envelope burn reaches 110% of monthly allocation
Company envelope burn reaches 125% of monthly allocation

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $100/month Support envelope on a daily basis and is correctly tagged to a production environment, routing it to COGS with no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $200/month Data envelope and carries a routine pipeline tag, so this charge is admitted and classified as OpEx without intervention.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; the most likely cause is an accidental model tier upgrade or a prompt-length regression introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window and the requested cost delta is within the $1,000 max_delta_usd cap, so this exception is approved without escalation.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step 2 throttle; the unattributed spend is paused pending a valid project tag, preserving the engineer's ability to resume once attribution is confirmed.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the $600 single-transaction ceiling and the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card, so the transaction is approved and recorded.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial overlaps with the Sales team's $1,400/year contract running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool was submitted as COGS, but the internal-tool project tag maps explicitly to OpEx under the classification rules; the charge is reclassified to OpEx.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are within policy parameters and no outstanding escalations remain open.
